reason: A canvas-based DeepSeek Harness plugin for configuring directed agent graphs, spawning agent instances, routing messages, and persisting or transferring cluster configuration.

summaries.zh: 通过画布节点图配置智能体及其信息流，支持创建智能体实例、发送消息，并保存或导入集群配置。
summaries.en: A canvas-based DeepSeek Harness plugin for configuring agent graphs, spawning agent instances, routing messages, and saving or loading cluster configurations.

capabilities: orchestrates multiple agent instances through a directed canvas graph
creates fresh agent instances and sends messages to running instances
persists agent definitions and graph data to host filesystem
exports and loads graph and agent configuration
